trajectory: W4 headwind original scheduler from takeoff. Replay must keep 140000 bit and 111310.32858681791 J.
arrival: A sample taken at or before a decision can be sent then. It is usable at the first later decision at or after send time plus the existing 32-byte airtime, and not at the sending decision.
score_at: receiver actual position at t plus the horizon, only when that time is within the mission
extrapolation: Hold the action committed at the first second of the current decision. Repeat that action's 30 s phase schedule. Do not read a later decision's action. Wind is not used to move the predicted position.
selection: At each decision, send one available sample. Rank by the mean predictive variance of the wind at the extrapolated horizon points, given samples that have already arrived. A tie within 1e-9 keeps the newer sample. The rule reads positions, times, and the registered kernel only.
receiver_already_knows: Known ripple, prior, kernel scales, own pose, the action committed for this decision, and the identities and values of samples that have already arrived. The choice does not read sample values, the hidden perturbation, the true future track, or the true wind.
estimator: One linear-Gaussian update of the global mean plus the registered kernel. Each sample id enters once. No message uses prior mean 0, so the prediction is the known ripple.
sensor: Point wind at the observer position and time, plus independent Gaussian noise of 0.5 m/s on each component. This is the existing observation interface. Position is not advected by wind. The local scenario adds the hidden perturbation before the noise.
control_field: Existing ax plus the known ripple. Local amplitude is 0, so equal-noise samples are exchangeable observations of the global mean.

local_field.components: x and y are independent and use the same kernel

geometry_before_comparison.relation: 相关长度 600 m 位于最近间隔 504.5 m 与中位间隔 1205.5 m 之间，并接近 30 秒满速航段 540 m。时间尺度 90 s 长于一次决策、短于结构风周期 1200 s。幅度 2 m/s 高于观测噪声 0.5 m/s、低于先验 8 m/s。10 秒采样、30 秒发送：满速时相邻样本相距 180 m，约为相关长度的 0.3 倍；每次发送窗口有多条尚未发送的样本，地点才可能改变选择。尺度在比较之前固定。

support_rule: A horizon is supported only when, on every local seed, the full-trajectory wind-vector RMSE of the relevant sample is at least 0.0001 m/s below the latest-sample method. Beating the no-message prior is not support. The numerical floor only excludes an exact tie.
rmse: sqrt of the mean of squared east and north errors, in m/s

checks.name: frozen_trajectory
checks.catches: 回放的路径不是 W4 逆风原调度，按时 bit 或全队耗电偏离 140000 bit 和 111310.32858681791 J。

checks.name: future_isolation
checks.catches: 发送时选中了更晚的样本，或选择读了测值、真实未来位置或真风。

checks.name: equal_budget
checks.catches: 两种发送方法的报文条数或字节数不同，或同一次机会发出多于一条。

checks.name: zero_amplitude
checks.catches: 幅度为 0 时地点仍改变选择，或后验不再等于与地点无关的均值。
